tvs.text-bl-seo-2:
Benefits of powder brows

This technique suits absolutely everyone. If you want a beautiful tattoo, choose powder brows. Whatever your age, skin type or coloring, the technique is completely universal. Even on oily skin, where microblading is contraindicated, powder-effect eyebrow micropigmentation looks excellent. This technique also offers the following benefits:
it is quick to do and long-lasting. The procedure takes no more than 1 hour 30 min, including the consultation and drawing the sketch. The effect stays visible for 1 to 2 years;
there is no discomfort during powder brows micropigmentation, because the pigment is placed in the upper layers of the skin;
allergic reactions are ruled out thanks to special mineral-based hypoallergenic pigments.
Powder brows save you a lot of time on daily makeup. Wherever you are and whatever you are doing, your brows will look well-groomed and gorgeous. Most importantly, this micropigmentation technique avoids the rigid shapes and intense colors that were in vogue 20 years ago. So the permanent makeup doesn’t make your eyes or face look heavy, and you don’t need to keep filling in your lashes and brows to look harmonious.

Stages of the powder-effect eyebrow micropigmentation procedure

First, the artist gives you a consultation on everything you’d like to know. The pigment is selected individually based on your color type. If needed, the artist may blend two or three pigments to get the ideal shade. Next:

  1. The sketch is drawn. It lets the client see the brow shape and make adjustments if needed, and lets the artist strictly follow the marked boundaries and lines to keep the proportions correct.
  2. The procedure begins. Note that the artist does not apply an anesthetic before starting the micropigmentation. It isn’t needed, since powder brows cause minimal trauma to the skin. After the first stage, an additional anesthetic is applied to reduce pain during the rest of the pigment application and to relieve redness and swelling, which are normal skin reactions.
  3. The procedure is completed. The artist will give you aftercare advice and book your touch-up, which is recommended 30–45 days after the first session.

About the touch-up

To get a complete, long-lasting result with powder brows, a touch-up is a must. You can skip it, but keep in mind that:

  • as the skin heals, the pigment retains a different percentage of its shade depending on your body – anywhere from 100% to 20%. The touch-up will saturate the brows with color and give them the desired shade;
  • as the skin regenerates and sheds pigment, small imperfections can form and become visible. A powder brows touch-up solves this by covering minor flaws;
  • the touch-up extends the effect by introducing pigment into the skin again.

About aftercare following your micropigmentation session

Aftercare doesn’t require any special measures. We don’t recommend applying ointments or creams to speed up skin recovery, as we believe the skin should heal on its own. Still, for safety and to prevent infection, we recommend using chlorhexidine or a similar product for the first few days. Aftercare involves:

  • avoiding direct UV exposure of your powder brows, including tanning beds. For one month, while the skin recovers, it is important to protect your brows from the sun with a hat, cap or sunglasses, or to use SPF40+ sunscreen;
  • avoiding steaming the skin: no sauna, no swimming pool and no hot baths;
  • washing with lukewarm water and a gentle cleanser: micellar water or a low-pH liquid soap;
  • avoiding any physical contact with your brows. No scratching, massaging or trying to remove flaking skin.

The final result, and how long the tattoo stays visible, depend on how carefully you follow these recommendations.

Powder-effect eyebrow micropigmentation – the No. 1 technique worldwide

Powder-effect eyebrow micropigmentation has no equal. It is the only way to get gorgeous, natural-looking brows that accentuate, rejuvenate and visually transform your face. Even dense or unruly hairs look much neater against a beautiful background. This way, you will save considerable time and money on daily brow makeup.
tvs.text-bl-seo: Powder brow tattooing truly is the most popular and accessible technique worldwide. This is down to how the brows look after the session: they keep their beauty and natural appearance, and at first glance it is hard to tell they have been tattooed. They look like high-quality makeup applied with eyeshadow or a pencil. The brows keep their own shape; the artist only refines them with classic, correct lines to eliminate asymmetry and give them an even look.

migx_questions.questions-text: Powder brows are considered the most painless technique, thanks to minimal skin trauma and the pigment being applied as a fine spray. An anesthetic may or may not be used during the procedure, which is why powder-effect micropigmentation is the only technique offered to pregnant women and breastfeeding new mothers.

migx_questions.questions-title: Who are powder brows not recommended for?
migx_questions.questions-text: Powder-effect eyebrow micropigmentation has no restrictions. It can be done for women of any age and with any skin type.

migx_questions.questions-title: What is the difference between powder-effect eyebrow micropigmentation and a tattoo?
migx_questions.questions-text: With a tattoo, the pigment is packed in solidly, whereas with powder brows it is applied using a powdering technique. The difference in effect is clearly visible – powder brows look more natural and softer.

migx_questions.questions-title: Which is more effective: powder-effect eyebrow micropigmentation or a tattoo?
migx_questions.questions-text: It all depends on your preferences and goals. Powder-effect brows give a natural look and don’t require clearly defined edges. That said, the powdering acts as a base tone for your natural hairs. If you want a defined shape created by the artist, it is better to choose a tattoo in a different technique.
